title: API FAQ | Smartsheet Developers
snippet:
**Is there a fee to use the API?**
No. The use of the API is free to all Smartsheet customers, regardless of plan, and third party application developers.

If you are an application developer, we are committed to making it easy to build on top of Smartsheet - whether you are developing a solution for your organization or creating an app for the Smartsheet customer community at large. Use standard OAuth2 authentication and authorization to safely access Smartsheet data on behalf of your users without requesting or storing their usernames or passwords. Take advantage of granular access scopes to request only the level of access required for your app. To get the ball rolling,[ sign up](http://smartsheet.com/developers/register) for a Smartsheet developer account, register your app to get app key and secret and follow our[ docs](http://smartsheet.com/developers/api-documentation) to create your first Smartsheet app.

title: Integrations
snippet: The Smartsheet API is free and available for use for any users with a Smartsheet license on a Business plan or higher. For more information on the Smartsheet API, please review ​​[5 steps for getting started with the Smartsheet API](https://smartsheet.com/content-center/best-practices/tips-tricks/api-getting-started).

title: Smartsheet Pricing in 2026: Pro vs Business, the 10-Member Cap, and Why Automations Need Business
snippet:
As of October 9, 2026, Smartsheet Pro costs $9 per member a month billed yearly ($12 monthly) for up to 10 members, Business $19 billed yearly ($24 monthly) with a 3-member minimum, and Enterprise is custom. Contributors are free. Pro has no API access and 250 automated triggers a month, so a team that connects Smartsheet to a website, an AI tool or other software needs Business.

**As of October 9, 2026, Smartsheet has four plans: Pro at $9 per member a month billed yearly ($12 monthly) for 1 to 10 members, Business at $19 per member a month billed yearly ($24 monthly) with a 3-member minimum, and Enterprise and Advanced Work Management at custom prices. Contributors are free on every plan. The catch for anyone automating work: Pro has no API access and stops at 250 automated triggers a month, so most automation builds start on Business.**

| Plan | Price per member | Members | Automated triggers | API access | Outside AI tools | Storage |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pro | $9 billed yearly, $12 monthly | 1 to 10 | 250 a month | No | No | 20 GB, 30 MB per file |
| Business | $19 billed yearly, $24 monthly | 3 or more | Unlimited | Yes | Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini Enterprise | 1 TB, 250 MB per file |
| Enterprise | Custom | 10 or more | Unlimited | Yes | Same, plus HubSpot, Dynamics 365, ServiceNow, DocuSign | Unlimited |
| Advanced Work Management | Custom | Custom | Unlimited | Yes | Enterprise list plus included premium apps | Unlimited |
Smartsheet's built-in AI features (Smart Assist, Smart Columns, the AI dashboard builder, formula generation and data analysis) are on every plan, Pro included. What Pro lacks is the connection to outside AI tools and the API. Smartsheet also says the Pro plan is only available to new customers, and it offers a 30-day free trial with no credit card.
## Members, Contributors and Guests
Smartsheet bills by Member. Every plan includes unlimited free Contributors, and Business and above add unlimited free Guests. The pricing page does not spell out what a Contributor can and cannot do, so before you count someone as free, check their role in Smartsheet's help center; the seat math below assumes everyone who builds sheets or automations is a Member.
